text:
Predicates:
MountainRange(x) ::: x is a mountain range.
Location(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Visited(x, y) ::: x visited y.
Donated(x) ::: x was donated.
HasMine(x) ::: x has a mine.
Premises:
Location(picurisMountains, newMexico) ∨ Location(picurisMountains, texas) ::: The Picuris Mountains are a mountain range in New Mexico or Texas.
Visited(juanDeOnate, picurisMountains) ::: Juan de Onate visited the Picuris Mountains.
Location(hardingPegmatiteMine, picurisMountains) ∧ Donated(hardingPegmatiteMine) ::: The Harding Pegmatite Mine, located in the Picuris Mountains, was donated.
¬∃x (MountainRange(x) ∧ Location(x, texas) ∧ HasMine(x) ∧ Donated(x)) ::: There are no mountain ranges in Texas that have mines which have been donated.
Conclusion:
∃x (Visited(juanDeOnate, x) ∧ Location(x, texas)) ::: Juan de Onate visited a mountain range in Texas.
